text: Regional managers should only see their own territory. This is exactly the dynamic RLS scenario Chapter Eleven built toward.
One role, one filter, matched against a user-mapping table — every manager sees only their own region, across all three report pages at once, since RLS filters the whole model.
Validate before trusting it. Confirm the filter works, and that your mapping table's email format matches what the service actually returns, before adding a single real person.
A nightly refresh is realistic here — this dashboard was never scoped for real-time data.
Share the app with exactly who the scope intended, granting view access only — nothing more than this project ever called for.
Security configured, refresh scheduled, access matched to scope. Lesson 93 closes the whole course: presenting the finished dashboard.
